note: FACTIONS pane of the OpenZone admin window -- its own pbo and its own layout, because a server without the faction mod never loads this file and the core must not know the pane exists. OZF_VppPane.OnCreate builds it under M_SUB_WIDGET and calls RegisterPane(factions, FACTIONS, pane, FacHint), so the root stands at [0, vpp.paneY] and starts hidden, exactly like the core panes. Names OZF_VppPane.c resolves by string: FacSearch, FacCfgList, FacSlug, FacLabel, FacLimit (the last four through the inherited SetEdit/GetEdit), InfoName, InfoDiscord, InfoSteam, InfoFaction, InfoRank, InfoTraits, BtnFacLeaderText, BtnRankText, BtnFRankText, BtnTraitText, FacRoster, FacHint -- plus twenty button names dispatched in OnClick: BtnFacLeader, BtnFacNew, BtnFacSave, BtnFacDel, BtnRank, BtnRankSet, BtnRankClear, BtnFRank, BtnFRankSet, BtnFRankClear, BtnTrait, BtnTraitAdd, BtnTraitDel, BtnPSpawn, BtnPSpawnClear, BtnWipe, BtnAssign, BtnLead, BtnClearFac, BtnRoster. Tokens come from the core repository through [build] tokens: the admin window is a platform surface and its palette is not this mod's to own. Console captions stay English (CONTRIBUTING.md).

frame.name: PaneFactions
frame.note: Hidden: ShowPane shows the open tab's pane and hides the rest.

vbox.name: FacBody
vbox.note: The whole vertical budget, against 524 - 2 * 20 = 484 units: 320 (the two columns) + 10 + 122 (the roster band) + 10 + 22 (FacHint) = 484, nothing left over. Each column is 470 wide, 20 apart, 470 + 20 + 470 = 960 = 1000 - 2 * 20. Inside a column, seven children over six gaps of 6 leave 320 - 172 - 36 = 112 units for the one child that fills -- the faction list on the left, the player card on the right. The roster band could not also carry a section head: 30 + 6 more would cut FacRoster from four visible rows to three, and four rows of players are worth more than a second caption over a list whose buttons already name it.

field.name: FacSearch
field.note: Filter over the list below; OnChange rebuilds FacCfgList on every keystroke.

listbox.name: FacCfgList
listbox.note: The engine's own listbox, filled by AddItem. Four lines over 112 units keeps a 28-unit row against the 30 of the hand-written pane; the search field above it is what reaches a faction the four rows do not show, because NoScrollBar is the old prop and stays.

hbox.name: FacFormActs
hbox.note: All four in one row: 148 + 60 + 118 + 126 = 452 plus three gaps of 6 = 470. The widest caption is LEADER POST: yes, 16 characters -- the hand-written pane fitted it into 130 units at 12 point, so 148 units at the 13 of $font.small has room, and REMOVE FACTION at 14 characters has 126. Two rows of two would cost 36 units and the faction list has none to give.

vbox.name: FacCard
vbox.note: Six caption-and-value rows, 18 units each = 108 inside the 112 this column has left. FillPlayerCard still writes its own word in front of five of the six values (discord:, steam:, faction:, stalker rank:, traits:) -- the captions here make those prefixes redundant, and trimming them is a one-line change in OZF_VppPane.c that this layout-only commit deliberately does not make. InfoName carries the empty-selection line; the script's own version of it still says on the right and is stale now that the roster sits below.

label.name: InfoName
label.text: pick a player in the roster below

hbox.name: FacRankRow
hbox.note: Cycler plus its two actions on ONE row: 214 + 122 + 122 = 458 plus two gaps of 6 = 470. The hand-written pane needed two rows for each of the three ladders because its middle column was only 270 wide; at 470 the pair fits beside the cycler and the three ladders cost three rows instead of six.

field.name: PSpRadius
field.note: GUARDED SPOT ONE. This box used to be a bare EditBoxWidgetClass with nothing behind it -- invisible until clicked, and mod_lint's editbox-bare rule caught it. The field primitive cannot make that mistake: it always emits PSpRadiusFrame (edge) holding PSpRadiusFill (panel) and the edit box, so the frame is a property of the primitive, not of somebody remembering to add two panels.

text.name: WipeNote
text.text: Permadeath: PDAs freeze forever, private chats are left, roles reset to novice. Press twice.
text.note: GUARDED SPOT TWO. As a plain TextWidget this line had no wrapping at all: the gallery of 2026-09-04 measured it 683 x 21 px inside a box of 415 x 83 px and it crossed FacHint by 415 x 33 px. The arithmetic in layout units, at the 1600-high screen where 280 units rendered as 415 px (1.482 px per unit): the string is 683 / 1.482 = 461 units on one line and a line of $font.tiny is 21 / 1.482 = 14.2 units tall. In this 294-unit box 461 / 294 = 1.57, so it wraps to two lines = 28.4 units, and the row is $size.header = 34 -- five units of slack. plain makes it a MultilineTextWidgetClass with wrap 1, and grow false pins size to text v at 0, so a longer translation clips inside the row instead of growing down into the roster band.

hbox.name: FacRosterRow
hbox.note: The roster gets the whole width the pane has: 690 for the list and 250 for the four actions, 690 + 20 + 250 = 960. The old pane gave it a 280-unit column, so a row now holds the name, the offline mark and the faction without truncating.

listbox.name: FacRoster
listbox.note: No NoScrollBar, exactly as the hand-written pane had it: the roster is as long as the server is busy and its bar is what reaches row twenty. Four lines over 122 units = 30.5 per row, the same row the old 300 / 10 gave.

vbox.name: FacRosterActs
vbox.note: Four buttons of equal share: (122 - 3 * 6) / 4 = 26 units each. Stacked beside the list rather than in a row under it -- ASSIGN TO SELECTED FACTION is 26 characters and wants the full 250.

label.name: FacHint
label.note: Empty: RegisterPane named it the pane's hint, and every answer of the faction routes lands here.
